info.title: UNICORE CRM API Contract — Phase 18 Shipping & Returns
info.description: Canonical production HTTP contract through Phase 18. OpenAPI is the sole production HTTP authority. Shipping booking, carrier selection, tracking, delivery and COD evidence plus Return eligibility, receipt, inspection and resolution are server-backed with decimal-string Money, idempotency, concurrency and backend-owned cross-module sagas. Operations marked x-contract-status=BLOCKED MUST NOT be implemented or invoked.

healthAssessment.description: Customers-owned purchase-recency assessment calculated on read. Omitted for archived Customers.

nextCareAt.description: Legacy compatibility read only; not mutable in Customer CU.

HandoverLeadWithTasksRequest.x-workflow-semantics: Tasks authoritatively discovers and transfers all eligible OPEN nonarchived Lead Tasks and creates exactly one NORMAL takeover Task with frozen workspace SLA. Durable recovery completes ownership before success.

IdempotencyKey.description: Stable key scoped by workspace, operation and authenticated actor.

ImportLeadBatchRequest.x-atomic-semantics: All Lead profiles are validated before commit. Any invalid row, duplicate business contact or authorization failure rejects the complete batch.

InvoiceDraftCreateRequest.description: Client draft intent. Backend validates source Order eligibility and calculates all line/document totals using the canonical money policy.

InvoiceDraftMutationResponse.description: Authoritative create/save Invoice draft mutation outcome. The backend assigns aggregate identifiers, version, timestamps, totals and audit evidence.

lineId.description: Server-issued line identifier. Omit for a new draft line.

InvoiceDraftSaveRequest.description: Mutable DRAFT fields only. Lifecycle, IDs, currency, source links, versions, totals and audit evidence are server-owned.

InvoiceDraftSourceLinksRequest.description: References used to validate invoiceability. Backend must re-read the Order and may not trust client quantity or eligibility assertions.

LeadCustomFieldValue.x-value-invariant: Exactly one value field matching valueType must be present.

LeadDirectSaleLineInput.description: Commercial input only. Line subtotal, discount result, tax amount, total, rounding and downstream document numbers are backend-owned.

ownerId.description: Null means authoritative UNASSIGNED. Non-null is an authoritative workspace member.

LeadDocument.x-profile-authority: Editable profile values are returned authoritatively; lifecycle, score, version, timestamps and activity projection remain server-owned.

LeadQualificationOpportunityInput.description: Requires either needSummary or at least one interestedProductId. Deal stage, score, timestamps, IDs and monetary calculations are backend-owned.

LeadQualificationRelationshipRequest.description: Closed relationship-resolution intent. EXISTING requires selectedId. NEW CONTACT requires contact. NEW ORGANIZATION_ACCOUNT requires contact and organization. Identity matching, merge policy and authoritative IDs are backend-owned.

LeadQualificationWorkflowResult.description: Authoritative workflow output. IDs and versions are server-assigned evidence; the frontend must not fabricate downstream records.

LeadVerificationProfileInput.x-value-invariant: Only accepted when targetWorkState is VERIFYING. Omitted fields remain unchanged.

ManualPaymentResponse.description: Authoritative manual-payment recording result. Backend assigns record and credit identifiers and owns ledger effects.

OrderCreditApprovalState.description: Single-use, version-bound Order credit approval evidence. No wall-clock expiry is defined in P0.6; a binding change supersedes the approval.

OrderReadModel.description: Authoritative Order read projection. Credit-policy evaluation is not approval evidence; an optional creditApproval summary is server-owned, version-bound and single-use.

primaryContactId.description: Legacy compatibility projection only; Contact C6 relationship state is authoritative.

contactRefs.description: Legacy compatibility projection only; Contact C6 relationship state is authoritative.

PercentageRate.description: Decimal percentage from 0 through 100 inclusive. Backend owns rounding and calculated amounts.

ProductDocument.x-money-semantics: unitPrice and costPrice are authoritative decimal-string Money. Numeric frontend fields are display-only projections.

QualifyLeadDirectSaleRequest.description: Backend checks Lead qualification permission plus downstream Quote/Order capability and module availability. No hidden Deal is created.

QuoteReadModel.description: Authoritative Quote read projection. quoteRevision is business revision; resourceVersion is optimistic concurrency authority.

ReopenDisqualifiedLeadRequest.x-command-invariant: Only a CLOSED Lead with qualificationOutcome DISQUALIFIED may be reopened. The backend restores CONTACTING and clears disqualification evidence according to the canonical lifecycle rule.

ownerId.description: Must match the existing owner; profile replacement cannot assign or unassign.

ReplaceLeadProfileRequest.x-replacement-semantics: Full replacement of editable Lead profile fields. Omitted optional properties are cleared. Lifecycle, score, identity resolution and audit fields are not editable here.

RequestRefundCancellationResponse.description: Cancellation request accepted. RefundIntent is not CANCELLED until the provider attempt acknowledges cancellation.

ResourceVersion.description: Monotonic optimistic-concurrency version serialized through ETag/If-Match.

RetryRefundIntentResponse.description: Retry request accepted. Backend creates a new server-assigned provider attempt linked to the failed predecessor.

ReturnReadModel.x-application-projection: correlationId is optional read evidence; absence must not be replaced with a server-like value by the frontend.

ScheduleLeadFollowUpBatchRequest.x-command-invariant: The backend atomically schedules the follow-up, advances NEW Leads to CONTACTING when allowed, and emits timeline evidence for every Lead.

ShippingBookingReadModel.x-application-projection: Command idempotency keys are intentionally excluded. Money remains decimal-string authoritative data.

ContactRelationshipSummaryReadModel.description: Permission-filtered relationship projection owned by the Contacts backend boundary.

Customer360Metrics.description: Only metrics proven by authorized owning-module participants are present; absence is not numeric zero.

healthAssessment.description: Same Customers-owned assessment semantics exposed on Customer reads.

Customer360ReadModel.description: Backend-composed, permission-filtered Customer 360 projection. The frontend must not rebuild it through N+1 module queries.

OrganizationOverviewMetrics.description: Permission-filtered metrics. Organization/C6-owned representativeCount is always present; unsupported cross-owner facts are omitted.

DealForecastSummaryReadModel.description: Permission-filtered Deal forecast projection grouped by currency. No cross-currency conversion is performed by the frontend.

ReplaceQuoteDraftRequest.description: Replaces the editable Quote draft profile and lines before repricing.

CreateQuoteForDealRequest.description: Creates a Quote for the Deal in the path. Backend derives and validates buyer/source relationship from the Deal.

ProductDraftInput.description: Closed Product draft input. Backend owns identity, version, timestamps, archive evidence and pricing projection.

ReplaceProductRequest.description: Closed Product draft input. Backend owns identity, version, timestamps, archive evidence and pricing projection.

ProductBatchMutationResponse.description: Authoritative atomic Product batch mutation response.

ProductAvailabilityReadModel.description: Backend-owned Product availability projection for order eligibility.

ProductPriceProjectionReadModel.description: Backend-owned price projection. Frontend must not treat local calculations as commercial authority.

OrderBatchMutationResponse.description: Authoritative atomic Order batch mutation response.

PaymentRequestDeliveryResponse.description: Authoritative Payment Request delivery evidence response.

botToken.description: Write-only sensitive input. Never include in examples, telemetry, browser storage or responses. Real input requires separately approved live environment and healthy persistent custody.

x-shared-conventions.workspaceAuthority: Authenticated membership is validated server-side; X-Workspace-Id is routing context, not trusted authority.
x-shared-conventions.money: Decimal string amount plus ISO 4217 currency.
x-shared-conventions.time: UTC instants use RFC 3339 Z timestamps; accounting dates use full-date.
x-shared-conventions.pagination: Cursor based with stable allow-listed sorting.
x-shared-conventions.errors: Stable ApiErrorEnvelope; raw diagnostics are never user-facing.
x-shared-conventions.idempotency: Mutation operations use Idempotency-Key; the key is scoped and retained server-side.
x-shared-conventions.commercialWorkflow: Lead qualification may create downstream records only through its typed workflow outcome. Quote acceptance atomically accepts the Quote and marks its linked Deal WON when present; it never creates an Order. Accepted-Quote conversion and direct Order draft creation are separate idempotent commands. Server state owns product price snapshots, totals, versions, actor, workspace and time.
